description: Follow-up from op-b1y5. The 'kovan folder' project format design (docs/kovan-folder-format.md, op-63u0) specifies kovan.toml's document.id as the .bib entry's cite key, joining bib/PDF/markdown by that key. op-b1y5's v1 implementation (crates/kovan/src/project.rs) cannot do this join today because this workspace has no BibTeX PARSER anywhere -- kovan_literature::bibtex::to_bibtex only renders a KovanDocument INTO BibTeX (one-way), there is no read path for an arbitrary user-authored .bib file. v1 instead joins pdf/<stem>.pdf <-> markdown/<stem>.md by shared filename stem, which works but does not match the design doc's spec and cannot associate a document with its actual bib entry. Natural home: kovan-literature (alongside bibtex.rs). Scope: parse a .bib file into a list of (cite_key, fields) entries -- does not need to produce a full KovanDocument, just enough to drive project.rs's regenerate() to join on cite key instead of filename stem.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
Implemented. Natural home confirmed and used: `kovan-literature/src/bibtex.rs` (alongside `to_bibtex`).

What shipped:
- `kovan_literature::parse_bib_entries(&str) -> Result<Vec<BibEntry>, BibParseError>` -- a hand-rolled, offline, brace-balanced parser (no new dependency; consistent with this workspace's offline-deterministic style). Handles `@type{key, field = {value}, ...}` and `field = "value"`/bare (`year = 2020`) forms, nested braces inside a `{...}` value, trailing commas, and `%`-commented/blank text between entries. `@string`/`@preamble`/`@comment` blocks are brace-balanced past and dropped (not citable entries).
- `BibEntry { entry_type, cite_key, fields: BTreeMap<String, String> }` -- deliberately shallow, per this bead's own scope note: no attempt to reconstruct a `KovanDocument`, just enough for an exact-match cite-key join. Field values keep their TeX escapes as written (not unescaped) -- documented as a known limitation in the module doc.
- Both re-exported at the `kovan-literature` crate root.

Consumer wired in the same pass (closes the gap `op-b1y5`'s v1 flagged): `crates/kovan/src/project.rs`'s `regenerate()` now parses the project's `.bib` file and joins by cite key (design doc's actual spec) instead of by filename stem alone -- a document exists only when a `.bib` entry's cite key has both a matching `pdf/<key>.pdf` and `markdown/<key>.md` on disk. Added `ProjectError::Bib` for a malformed `.bib` file. Updated the module doc's "known v1 scoping limitation" note to reflect this is now closed, and fixed 3 existing tests whose fixture `.bib` cite keys didn't match their pdf/markdown stems (previously harmless since the join ignored the bib file's content entirely).

Verified:
- `kovan-literature`: 18 bibtex tests (13 new), 52 lib tests total, all passing.
- `kovan`: 4 new project.rs tests (mainline join, stem-with-no-cite-key skip, cite-key-with-no-files skip, malformed .bib error) + all 12 pre-existing project tests (3 fixture-updated), 181 lib tests total, all passing.
- `cargo check --all-targets` clean on both crates, native and `--target aarch64-linux-android`.
- `cargo doc --no-deps`: no new warnings on either crate.
- Regenerated both crates' `docs/<crate>-api.md` mirrors via `kovan-cli api-docs`.

Not implemented (correctly out of scope for this bead, tracked separately): the actual JabRef-like bibliography *editor* UI (op-9vml's other half) -- this bead only unblocks it by providing the read path. op-9vml itself is left as-is; a comment there notes the unblock.

Not committed/pushed yet per this workspace's never-auto-commit rule.

title: kovan-literature: BibTeX parser (read .bib -> KovanDocument-ish entries), needed for kovan.toml's bib-key document join
